## Billing.handleStripeWebhook — POST /webhooks/stripe
Intent: Receive a Stripe webhook: verify the signature over the raw body, record the event id once, apply the subscription change. Replays are acknowledged without a second effect.
Who may: public   [declared]
Ensures:
  - acknowledged: result.received = true and result.eventId = input.id   [declared]
  - recordedOnce: exactly one webhookEvent where eventId = input.id, provider = "stripe"   [declared]
Effects: reads WebhookEvent (ensures)   (declared: db:write, event:emit, unverified)

## Org.acceptInvite — POST /invitations/:token/accept
Intent: The signed-in user whose email matches a pending invitation joins the organization with the invited role.
Who may: Auth.SignedInUser — actor.type = "user" and user exists where id = actor.id   [declared]
Requires:
  - invitationIsPending: self.status = "pending"   [declared]
  - emailMatchesActor: self.email = actor.email   [declared]
  - notAlreadyMember: no membership where organizationId = self.organizationId, userId = actor.id   [declared]
Ensures:
  - invitationAccepted: self.status = "accepted" and self.acceptedById = actor.id   [declared]
  - membershipCreated: exactly one membership where organizationId = old.organizationId, role = old.role, userId = actor.id   [declared]
  - resultRoleMatches: result.membership.role = old.role   [declared]
  - eventEmitted: InvitationAccepted emitted exactly 1   [declared]
Effects: reads Membership (requires, ensures), User (policy)   (declared: db:write, event:emit, unverified)

## Org.removeMember — DELETE /orgs/:orgId/members/:userId
Intent: Owners and admins remove members (admins cannot remove owners); anyone may leave. The last owner can never be removed; the person's open tasks are unassigned.
Who may: Org.AdminOrSelf — (actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, role in [owner, admin], userId = actor.id) or (actor.type = "apiKey" and apiKey exists where id = actor.id, organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, revokedAt is null, role = "admin") or (actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, userId = actor.id and input.userId = actor.id)   [declared]
Requires:
  - targetIsMember: membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, userId = input.userId   [declared]
  - onlyOwnersRemoveOwners: no membership where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner", userId = input.userId or (actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner", userId = actor.id) or input.userId = actor.id   [declared]
  - notTheLastOwner: no membership where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner", userId = input.userId or number of membership where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner" >= 2   [declared]
Ensures:
  - membershipGone: no membership where organizationId = input.orgId, userId = input.userId   [declared]
  - anOwnerRemains: membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner"   [declared]
  - tasksUnassigned: no task where assigneeId = input.userId, organizationId = input.orgId   [declared]
  … 2 more lines (inspect Action:Org.removeMember)

## Org.rotateApiKey — POST /orgs/:orgId/api-keys/:keyId/rotate
Intent: Rotate an API key's secret. The key keeps its identity, `version` increases and the previous secret stops working immediately.
Who may: Org.OwnerOrAdminUser — actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, role in [owner, admin], userId = actor.id   [declared]
Requires:
  - keyNotRevoked: self.revokedAt is null   [declared]
Ensures:
  - versionBumped: self.version > old.version   [declared]
  - rotatedAtSet: self.rotatedAt is set   [declared]
  - sameIdentity: result.id = input.keyId and result.version = self.version   [declared]
  - secretIsLong: length of result.secret >= 32   [declared]
  - eventEmitted: ApiKeyRotated emitted exactly 1   [declared]
Effects: reads Membership (policy)   (declared: db:write, event:emit, unverified)

## Org.updateMemberRole — PATCH /orgs/:orgId/members/:userId
Intent: Change a member's role. Only owners grant or revoke the owner role; nobody demotes the last owner.
Who may: Org.OwnerOrAdmin — (actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, role in [owner, admin], userId = actor.id) or (actor.type = "apiKey" and apiKey exists where id = actor.id, organization.deletedAt is null, organizationId = input.orgId, revokedAt is null, role = "admin")   [declared]
Requires:
  - targetIsMember: membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, userId = input.userId   [declared]
  - onlyOwnersTouchOwnerRole: (input.role != "owner" and self.role != "owner") or (actor.type = "user" and membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner", userId = actor.id)   [declared]
  - notDemotingLastOwner: self.role != "owner" or input.role = "owner" or number of membership where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner" >= 2   [declared]
Ensures:
  - roleApplied: self.role = input.role and result.role = input.role   [declared]
  - anOwnerRemains: membership exists where organizationId = input.orgId, role = "owner"   [declared]
  - eventEmittedWhenChanged: MemberRoleChanged emitted at most 1   [declared]
Effects: reads ApiKey (policy), Membership (policy, requires, ensures)   (declared: db:write, event:emit, unverified)
Tests: auth-matrix (1) generated, not run, event (1) generated, not run, postcondition (1) generated, not run, precondition (1) generated, not run
